title: Transfer Cluster of Academic Teaching Nursing Homes Center for Coordination and Transfer
summary:
It is neccessary, to improve the workload for nursing staff and the care of residents in nursing homes in Germany. This requires better cooperation between universities and nursing homes so that knowledge and innovations can be put into practice more quickly.  The “Transfer Cluster of Academic Teaching Nursing Homes (TCALL)” initiative aims to create sustainable transfer structures in long-term care. The cluster is intended to act as a bridge between science, education and care practice and enable a two-way transfer by creating a new sustainable culture of innovation in the areas of care, education and training in long-term care as well as in the area of establishing interdisciplinary partnerships between (nursing) scientists, nursing staff and (nursing) educators as well as business partners from the areas of development and sales of technical innovations. By creating sustainable innovation structures, TCALL contributes to increasing job satisfaction and the quality of care. 
The TCALL initiative combines several projects that work on different topics. The Coordination and Transfer Center project of the TCALL initiative is responsible for the strategic management, dissemination and overall evaluation of TCALL. Study participants are residents and employees in the participating nursing homes.

interventions.name:
Intervention group:
Three nursing homes in Bremen are restructered into academic teaching nursing homes. Over a total period of nine years, various innovations for care (technical, organizational, etc.) will be tested, evaluated and, if the evaluation is positive, implemented in these nursing homes

Control group:
In the control group of three matched nursing homes, no changes are made as part of the TCALL initiative. The same questionnaires as in the intervention nursing homes are used for the summative evaluation. The results allow a difference-in-difference analyses to draw conclusions abou

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Principally: voluntary participation

- Nursing homes:
Nursing homes in Bremen that have stated their interest, the selection resides with the TCALL initiative.

- Employees: 
Questionnaires and focus groups:  Direct involvement in the nursing care of residents

- Residents:
i) Survey: all residents who are able to complete a questionnaire independently or with support according to the assessment of the nursing staff. For cognitively impaired residents, for example, an external assessment is provided.
ii) Focus groups with residents who, according to the assessment of the care professionals, are cognitively able to do so
Exclusion criteria:
- Residents:
terminal residents, living in the respecting nursing home less than 6 weeks

- Employees:
survey: employment less than 4 weeks.
